datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Burkina Faso administrative units. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases for 2011, with multiple scenarios captured at four time points (January, April, July, October). Geographic boundaries and classification values were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
